dialogues.speaker: Captain Night Raven
dialogues.text: You've gotten rid of them? Thank you so much!

dialogues.speaker: Captain Night Raven
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll tell you how to get through the fog and locate the clue...

dialogues.speaker: Captain Night Raven
dialogues.text: If you're ready, come look for me on the other side of the reef!
